mods.name: Yumo CMP Reloaded
mods.description: Pack massive assembly lines into a compact machine, assess their production yield, and convert them into a single Factory Block.

releases.notes:
## Yumo CMP Reloaded 1.0.0

First stable release.

### Highlights
- Unified resource system with Mekanism chemical support
- Improved unpack safety, evaluator conversion checks, and overworld-only evaluation
- Removed the debug-only "Active" Jade tooltip on input/output blocks

### Changes since 0.9.1
- refactor: introduce unified resource system with Mekanism support
- fix: improve unpack safety, evaluator conversion checks, and overworld-only evaluation
- feat: remove Jade active debug tooltip
